###############################################################################
# Input variables
###############################################################################

variable "key_prefix" {
  description = "Prefix used when constructing the AWS key pair name."
  type        = string
  default     = "key"
}

###############################################################################
# Randomly generated two-word pet name identifier
###############################################################################

resource "random_pet" "this" {
  length    = 2
  separator = "-"
}

locals {
  # Fully qualified key pair name: <key_prefix>-<random-two-word-pet-name>
  key_name = "${var.key_prefix}-${random_pet.this.id}"

  # Absolute path to the parent directory above the working/module directory.
  key_dir = "${path.module}/.."

  # Absolute path to the generated private key file (named identically to the
  # key pair) that lives in the parent directory.
  key_path = "${local.key_dir}/${local.key_name}"
}

###############################################################################
# Dynamically generated 4096-bit RSA private key
###############################################################################

resource "tls_private_key" "this" {
  algorithm = "RSA"
  rsa_bits  = 4096
}

###############################################################################
# AWS key pair for SSH access, backed by the generated RSA key
###############################################################################

resource "aws_key_pair" "this" {
  key_name   = local.key_name
  public_key = tls_private_key.this.public_key_openssh
}

###############################################################################
# Local execution provisioner
#
# Persists the generated private key to the parent directory in PEM format,
# using the same name as the AWS key pair, and explicitly restricts the file
# permissions to 600 (owner read/write only).
###############################################################################

resource "null_resource" "private_key_file" {
  triggers = {
    key_name    = aws_key_pair.this.key_name
    private_key = tls_private_key.this.private_key_pem
  }

  provisioner "local-exec" {
    command = <<-EOT
      umask 077
      printf '%s' "${tls_private_key.this.private_key_pem}" > "${local.key_path}"
      chmod 600 "${local.key_path}"
    EOT
  }
}

terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.0"

  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = ">= 4.0"
    }
  }
}

locals {
  iam_user_name   = "TJ"
  iam_policy_name = "GlacierEFSEC2"

  tags = {
    Name      = "GlacierEFSEC2"
    ManagedBy = "Terraform"
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "glacier_efs_ec2" {
  # Broad EC2 management permissions.
  statement {
    sid    = "EC2Management"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:Describe*",
      "ec2:RunInstances",
      "ec2:StartInstances",
      "ec2:StopInstances",
      "ec2:RebootInstances",
      "ec2:TerminateInstances",
      "ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute",
      "ec2:CreateTags",
      "ec2:DeleteTags",
      "ec2:CreateVolume",
      "ec2:DeleteVolume",
      "ec2:AttachVolume",
      "ec2:DetachVolume",
      "ec2:CreateSnapshot",
      "ec2:DeleteSnapshot",
      "ec2:CreateSecurityGroup",
      "ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup",
      "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress",
      "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress",
      "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress",
      "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress",
      "ec2:AllocateAddress",
      "ec2:AssociateAddress",
      "ec2:DisassociateAddress",
      "ec2:ReleaseAddress",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  # EFS client-mount access.
  statement {
    sid    = "ElasticFileSystemClientMount"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "elasticfilesystem:ClientMount",
      "elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite",
      "elasticfilesystem:ClientRootAccess",
    ]
    resources = [
      "arn:aws:elasticfilesystem:*:*:file-system/*",
      "arn:aws:elasticfilesystem:*:*:access-point/*",
    ]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "ElasticFileSystemReadOnly"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "elasticfilesystem:DescribeFileSystems",
      "elasticfilesystem:DescribeMountTargets",
      "elasticfilesystem:DescribeAccessPoints",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  # Glacier vault and multipart-upload permissions.
  statement {
    sid    = "GlacierVaultAndMultipartUpload"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "glacier:CreateVault",
      "glacier:DeleteVault",
      "glacier:DescribeVault",
      "glacier:ListTagsForVault",
      "glacier:GetVaultAccessPolicy",
      "glacier:SetVaultAccessPolicy",
      "glacier:InitiateMultipartUpload",
      "glacier:UploadMultipartPart",
      "glacier:CompleteMultipartUpload",
      "glacier:AbortMultipartUpload",
      "glacier:ListMultipartUploads",
      "glacier:ListParts",
    ]
    resources = [
      "arn:aws:glacier:*:*:vaults/*",
    ]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "GlacierList"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "glacier:ListVaults",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "glacier_efs_ec2" {
  name        = local.iam_policy_name
  description = "Grants broad EC2 management, EFS client-mount, and Glacier vault/multipart-upload permissions."
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.glacier_efs_ec2.json

  tags = local.tags
}

  name = local.iam_user_name
  path = "/"

  tags = local.tags
}

  user       = aws_iam_user.tj.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.glacier_efs_ec2.arn
}

################################################################################
# Terraform / Provider Requirements
################################################################################

terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.5.0"

  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = ">= 5.0"
    }
  }
}

################################################################################
# Data Sources
################################################################################

data "aws_availability_zones" "available" {
  state = "available"
}

################################################################################
# Locals
################################################################################

locals {
  vpc_name = "multi-cluster-networking"
  vpc_cidr = "10.0.0.0/16"

  azs = slice(data.aws_availability_zones.available.names, 0, 3)

  # Three private subnets (/20) calculated with a prefix length extension of 4
  private_subnets = [for netnum in range(0, 3) : cidrsubnet(local.vpc_cidr, 4, netnum)]

  # Three public subnets (/24) calculated with a prefix length extension of 8,
  # starting at offset 48 (netnums 48, 49, 50)
  public_subnets = [for netnum in range(48, 51) : cidrsubnet(local.vpc_cidr, 8, netnum)]

  tags = {
    Blueprint  = local.vpc_name
    GithubRepo = "github.com/aws-ia/terraform-aws-eks-blueprints"
  }
}

################################################################################
# VPC (official AWS VPC module)
################################################################################

module "vpc" {
  source  = "terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws"
  version = "~> 5.21"

  name = local.vpc_name
  cidr = local.vpc_cidr

  azs             = local.azs
  private_subnets = local.private_subnets
  public_subnets  = local.public_subnets

  enable_nat_gateway = true
  single_nat_gateway = true

  enable_dns_hostnames = true
  enable_dns_support   = true

  public_subnet_tags = {
    "kubernetes.io/role/elb" = 1
  }

  private_subnet_tags = {
    "kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb" = 1
  }

  tags = local.tags
}

################################################################################
# Cross-Cluster Security Groups
#
# Two dedicated security groups inside the VPC. Each cluster's security group
# allows all protocols (ingress and egress) only to and from the *other*
# cluster's security group. Rules are declared as standalone
# aws_security_group_rule resources so the mutual references do not create a
# dependency cycle between the security group resources.
################################################################################

resource "aws_security_group" "cluster1_additional_sg" {
  name        = "cluster1_additional_sg"
  description = "Additional security group for cluster1 enabling communication with cluster2"
  vpc_id      = module.vpc.vpc_id

  tags = merge(local.tags, {
    Name = "cluster1_additional_sg"
  })

  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}

resource "aws_security_group" "cluster2_additional_sg" {
  name        = "cluster2_additional_sg"
  description = "Additional security group for cluster2 enabling communication with cluster1"
  vpc_id      = module.vpc.vpc_id

  tags = merge(local.tags, {
    Name = "cluster2_additional_sg"
  })

  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}

# Allow all inbound traffic to cluster1 from cluster2
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "cluster1_ingress_from_cluster2" {
  type                     = "ingress"
  description              = "Allow all inbound traffic from cluster2 security group"
  from_port                = 0
  to_port                  = 0
  protocol                 = "-1"
  security_group_id        = aws_security_group.cluster1_additional_sg.id
  source_security_group_id = aws_security_group.cluster2_additional_sg.id
}

# Allow all outbound traffic from cluster1 to cluster2
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "cluster1_egress_to_cluster2" {
  type                     = "egress"
  description              = "Allow all outbound traffic to cluster2 security group"
  from_port                = 0
  to_port                  = 0
  protocol                 = "-1"
  security_group_id        = aws_security_group.cluster1_additional_sg.id
  source_security_group_id = aws_security_group.cluster2_additional_sg.id
}

# Allow all inbound traffic to cluster2 from cluster1
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "cluster2_ingress_from_cluster1" {
  type                     = "ingress"
  description              = "Allow all inbound traffic from cluster1 security group"
  from_port                = 0
  to_port                  = 0
  protocol                 = "-1"
  security_group_id        = aws_security_group.cluster2_additional_sg.id
  source_security_group_id = aws_security_group.cluster1_additional_sg.id
}

# Allow all outbound traffic from cluster2 to cluster1
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "cluster2_egress_to_cluster1" {
  type                     = "egress"
  description              = "Allow all outbound traffic to cluster1 security group"
  from_port                = 0
  to_port                  = 0
  protocol                 = "-1"
  security_group_id        = aws_security_group.cluster2_additional_sg.id
  source_security_group_id = aws_security_group.cluster1_additional_sg.id
}

final_template:
variable "rolename" {
  description = "Name of the cross-account IAM role used by the third-party security auditing platform."
  type        = string
  default     = "WizAccess-Role"
}

variable "remote-arn" {
  description = "ARN of the remote AWS principal permitted to assume the cross-account role."
  type        = string
  default     = "arn:aws:iam::830522659852:role/prod-us43-AssumeRoleDelegator"
}

variable "external-id" {
  description = "External ID that must be supplied when assuming the cross-account role."
  type        = string
  default     = "fc959d31-537c-4108-8b87-9af9e0c9b8d2"
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "assume_role" {
  statement {
    sid     = "AllowCrossAccountAssumeRole"
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = [var.remote-arn]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "sts:ExternalId"
      values   = [var.external-id]
    }
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "wiz_access" {
  name               = var.rolename
  description        = "Cross-account role granting the third-party security auditing platform read/audit access."
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.assume_role.json

  tags = {
    Name = var.rolename
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy" "view_only_access" {
  name = "ViewOnlyAccess"
}

data "aws_iam_policy" "security_audit" {
  name = "SecurityAudit"
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "view_only_access" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.wiz_access.name
  policy_arn = data.aws_iam_policy.view_only_access.arn
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "security_audit" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.wiz_access.name
  policy_arn = data.aws_iam_policy.security_audit.arn
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "wiz_custom_policy" {
  # 1. Read-only access across multiple AWS services.
  statement {
    sid    = "ReadOnlyServiceAccess"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "acm:DescribeCertificate",
      "acm:ListCertificates",
      "apigateway:GET",
      "backup:DescribeBackupVault",
      "backup:GetBackupVaultAccessPolicy",
      "backup:ListBackupVaults",
      "cloudtrail:DescribeTrails",
      "cloudtrail:GetTrail",
      "cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus",
      "cloudtrail:ListTrails",
      "cloudtrail:LookupEvents",
      "codebuild:BatchGetProjects",
      "codebuild:ListProjects",
      "cognito-identity:DescribeIdentityPool",
      "cognito-identity:GetIdentityPoolRoles",
      "cognito-identity:ListIdentityPools",
      "connect:DescribeInstance",
      "connect:ListInstances",
      "dynamodb:DescribeTable",
      "dynamodb:ListTables",
      "ec2:DescribeInstances",
      "ec2:DescribeVolumes",
      "ec2:DescribeSnapshots",
      "ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups",
      "ecr:DescribeRepositories",
      "ecr:ListRepositories",
      "eks:DescribeCluster",
      "eks:ListClusters",
      "elasticfilesystem:DescribeFileSystems",
      "elasticmapreduce:DescribeCluster",
      "elasticmapreduce:ListClusters",
      "ssm:DescribeParameters",
      "ssm:GetParameter",
      "ssm:ListDocuments",
      "glacier:DescribeVault",
      "glacier:ListVaults",
      "glue:GetDatabase",
      "glue:GetDatabases",
      "glue:GetTables",
      "glue:ListDatabases",
      "health:DescribeEvents",
      "kafka:DescribeCluster",
      "kafka:ListClusters",
      "kendra:DescribeIndex",
      "kendra:ListIndices",
      "kinesisanalytics:DescribeApplication",
      "kinesisanalytics:ListApplications",
      "kinesisvideo:DescribeStream",
      "kinesisvideo:ListStreams",
      "kms:DescribeKey",
      "kms:GetKeyPolicy",
      "kms:ListKeys",
      "lambda:GetFunction",
      "lambda:ListFunctions",
      "logs:DescribeLogGroups",
      "logs:DescribeLogStreams",
      "logs:GetLogEvents",
      "logs:FilterLogEvents",
      "logs:StartQuery",
      "profile:GetProfile",
      "profile:ListProfiles",
      "profile:SearchProfiles",
      "s3:GetBucketLocation",
      "s3:GetBucketPolicy",
      "s3:ListAllMyBuckets",
      "s3:ListBucket",
      "ses:GetIdentityPolicy",
      "ses:ListIdentities",
      "voiceid:DescribeDomain",
      "voiceid:ListDomains",
      "wafv2:GetWebACL",
      "wafv2:ListWebACLs",
      "wisdom:GetAssistant",
      "wisdom:ListAssistants",
      "macie2:GetMacieSession",
      "macie2:ListFindings",
      "identitystore:DescribeGroup",
      "identitystore:ListUsers",
      "sso-directory:DescribeUsers",
      "sso-directory:ListUsers",
      "cloudwatch:GetMetricData",
      "cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics",
      "cloudwatch:ListMetrics"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  # 2. EBS snapshot creation and metadata retrieval.
  statement {
    sid    = "EbsSnapshotAccess"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:CopySnapshot",
      "ec2:CreateSnapshot",
      "ec2:GetEbsEncryptionByDefault",
      "ec2:DescribeSnapshots"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  # 3. Tag creation on EC2 snapshots in any region.
  statement {
    sid       = "SnapshotTagging"
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = ["ec2:CreateTags"]
    resources = ["arn:aws:ec2:*:*:snapshot/*"]
  }

  # 4. KMS alias creation on the wizKey alias and on any KMS key in any region/account.
  statement {
    sid     = "KmsAliasCreation"
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["kms:CreateAlias"]
    resources = [
      "arn:aws:kms:*:*:alias/wizKey",
      "arn:aws:kms:*:*:key/*"
    ]
  }

  # 5. KMS key policy management for resources tagged wiz = auto-gen-cmk.
  statement {
    sid    = "KmsKeyPolicyManagement"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "kms:GetKeyPolicy",
      "kms:PutKeyPolicy"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "aws:ResourceTag/wiz"
      values   = ["auto-gen-cmk"]
    }
  }

  # 6. Snapshot deletion/modification for resources tagged wiz = auto-gen-snapshot.
  statement {
    sid    = "SnapshotDeletionAndModification"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:DeleteSnapshot",
      "ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "ec2:ResourceTag/wiz"
      values   = ["auto-gen-snapshot"]
    }
  }

  # 7. Explicit deny for S3 object reads.
  statement {
    sid       = "WizAccessS3"
    effect    = "Deny"
    actions   = ["s3:GetObject"]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "wiz_custom_policy" {
  name   = "WizCustomPolicy"
  role   = aws_iam_role.wiz_access.id
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.wiz_custom_policy.json
}

###############################################################################
# Account-level EBS security settings
#
# This configuration enforces two account/region level EBS security controls:
#   1. Default EBS encryption for the region (aws_ebs_encryption_by_default)
#   2. Block public access to EBS snapshots (aws_ebs_snapshot_block_public_access)
#
# Both controls are gated behind a global enabling flag, an individual control
# flag, and operate against a target region that defaults to the region the
# provider is currently configured for.
###############################################################################

###############################################################################
# Variables
###############################################################################

variable "enable_ebs_security" {
  description = "Global flag controlling whether any account-level EBS security settings are managed by this configuration."
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "enable_ebs_encryption_by_default" {
  description = "Enable default EBS encryption for the target region."
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "block_public_snapshot_access" {
  description = "Block public access to EBS snapshots."
  type        = bool
  default     = true
}

variable "snapshot_block_public_access_state" {
  description = "The desired state for blocking public access to EBS snapshots. Valid values are 'block-all-sharing', 'block-new-sharing', and 'unblocked'."
  type        = string
  default     = "block-all-sharing"

  validation {
    condition = contains(
      ["block-all-sharing", "block-new-sharing", "unblocked"],
      var.snapshot_block_public_access_state
    )
    error_message = "The snapshot_block_public_access_state must be one of: block-all-sharing, block-new-sharing, unblocked."
  }
}

variable "region" {
  description = "Optional target AWS region. When null (the default), the provider's currently configured region is used."
  type        = string
  default     = null
}

###############################################################################
# Region resolution
#
# The provider is supplied externally, so we resolve the effective target region
# from the provider metadata and allow an explicit override via var.region.
###############################################################################

data "aws_region" "current" {}

locals {
  target_region = coalesce(var.region, data.aws_region.current.name)

  encryption_by_default_enabled = var.enable_ebs_security && var.enable_ebs_encryption_by_default
  snapshot_block_enabled        = var.enable_ebs_security && var.block_public_snapshot_access
}

###############################################################################
# Default EBS encryption for the region
###############################################################################

resource "aws_ebs_encryption_by_default" "this" {
  count = local.encryption_by_default_enabled ? 1 : 0

  enabled = true
}

###############################################################################
# Block public access to EBS snapshots
###############################################################################

resource "aws_ebs_snapshot_block_public_access" "this" {
  count = local.snapshot_block_enabled ? 1 : 0

  state = var.snapshot_block_public_access_state
}

###############################################################################
# Outputs
###############################################################################

output "target_region" {
  description = "The AWS region against which the account-level EBS security settings are applied."
  value       = local.target_region
}

output "ebs_encryption_by_default_enabled" {
  description = "Whether default EBS encryption is managed and enabled for the region."
  value       = local.encryption_by_default_enabled
}

output "ebs_snapshot_block_public_access_state" {
  description = "The effective state used to block public access to EBS snapshots."
  value       = local.snapshot_block_enabled ? var.snapshot_block_public_access_state : "unmanaged"
}

final_template:
variable "tags" {
  description = "A map of tags to apply to all supported resources."
  type        = map(string)
  default     = {}
}

locals {
  controlplane_role_name = "aws_ccm_k8s_controlplane"
  worker_role_name       = "aws_ccm_k8s_worker"

  ec2_assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Sid    = "AllowEC2AssumeRole"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Principal = {
          Service = "ec2.amazonaws.com"
        }
        Action = "sts:AssumeRole"
      }
    ]
  })
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Control Plane Role, Policy and Instance Profile
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "controlplane" {
  statement {
    sid    = "EC2Networking"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "ec2:CreateTags",
      "ec2:DeleteTags",
      "ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes",
      "ec2:DescribeAddresses",
      "ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones",
      "ec2:DescribeInstances",
      "ec2:DescribeInternetGateways",
      "ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces",
      "ec2:DescribeRouteTables",
      "ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups",
      "ec2:DescribeSubnets",
      "ec2:DescribeVpcs",
      "ec2:AssociateAddress",
      "ec2:DisassociateAddress",
      "ec2:CreateNetworkInterface",
      "ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface",
      "ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute",
      "ec2:CreateSecurityGroup",
      "ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup",
      "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress",
      "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress",
      "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress",
      "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "AutoScalingGroupDescription"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups",
      "autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances",
      "autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations",
      "autoscaling:DescribeTags",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "ElasticLoadBalancingManagement"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "elasticloadbalancing:AddListenerCertificates",
      "elasticloadbalancing:AddTags",
      "elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener",
      "elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer",
      "elasticloadbalancing:CreateRule",
      "elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DeleteRule",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListenerCertificates",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeRules",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroupAttributes",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups",
      "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth",
      "elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener",
      "elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes",
      "elasticloadbalancing:ModifyRule",
      "elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup",
      "elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes",
      "elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets",
      "elasticloadbalancing:RemoveListenerCertificates",
      "elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags",
      "elasticloadbalancing:SetIpAddressType",
      "elasticloadbalancing:SetSecurityGroups",
      "elasticloadbalancing:SetSubnets",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "KMSKeyDescription"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "kms:DescribeKey",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "CreateServiceLinkedRole"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "iam:AWSServiceName"
      values   = ["elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com"]
    }
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "controlplane" {
  name        = local.controlplane_role_name
  description = "Permissions for the AWS Cloud Controller Manager running on the Kubernetes control plane."
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.controlplane.json

  tags = var.tags
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "controlplane" {
  name               = local.controlplane_role_name
  description        = "IAM role assumed by the Kubernetes control plane for the AWS Cloud Controller Manager."
  assume_role_policy = local.ec2_assume_role_policy

  tags = var.tags
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "controlplane" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.controlplane.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.controlplane.arn
}

resource "aws_iam_instance_profile" "controlplane" {
  name = local.controlplane_role_name
  role = aws_iam_role.controlplane.name

  tags = var.tags
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Worker Role, Policy and Instance Profile
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "worker" {
  statement {
    sid    = "EC2InstanceAndRegionDescription"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "ec2:DescribeInstances",
      "ec2:DescribeRegions",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "ECRAuthorizationToken"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "ecr:GetAuthorizationToken",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "ECRReadOnly"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability",
      "ecr:BatchGetImage",
      "ecr:DescribeImages",
      "ecr:DescribeRepositories",
      "ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer",
      "ecr:ListImages",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "worker" {
  name        = local.worker_role_name
  description = "Permissions for the AWS Cloud Controller Manager running on Kubernetes worker nodes."
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.worker.json

  tags = var.tags
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "worker" {
  name               = local.worker_role_name
  description        = "IAM role assumed by Kubernetes worker nodes for the AWS Cloud Controller Manager."
  assume_role_policy = local.ec2_assume_role_policy

  tags = var.tags
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "worker" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.worker.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.worker.arn
}

resource "aws_iam_instance_profile" "worker" {
  name = local.worker_role_name
  role = aws_iam_role.worker.name

  tags = var.tags
}

###############################################################################
# IAM Access Management Infrastructure
#
# Establishes four IAM groups (admin, admin-terraform-cloud, github, serverless)
# with distinct paths, their inline/dedicated policies, corresponding IAM users
# and memberships, plus a "serverless" role and customer managed policy used for
# serverless (Lambda / Edge Lambda) deployment tooling.
###############################################################################

locals {
  admin_group_path           = "/admin/"
  admin_terraform_group_path = "/admin_terraform_cloud/"
  github_group_path          = "/github/"
  serverless_path            = "/serverless/"

  # AWS managed policy that grants full wildcard administrative permissions.
  administrator_access_policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess"
}

###############################################################################
# Groups
###############################################################################

# Admin group -- full wildcard administrative permissions.
resource "aws_iam_group" "admin" {
  name = "admin"
  path = local.admin_group_path
}

resource "aws_iam_group_policy_attachment" "admin" {
  group      = aws_iam_group.admin.name
  policy_arn = local.administrator_access_policy_arn
}

# Admin (Terraform Cloud) group -- full wildcard administrative permissions.
resource "aws_iam_group" "admin_terraform_cloud" {
  name = "admin-terraform-cloud"
  path = local.admin_terraform_group_path
}

resource "aws_iam_group_policy_attachment" "admin_terraform_cloud" {
  group      = aws_iam_group.admin_terraform_cloud.name
  policy_arn = local.administrator_access_policy_arn
}

# GitHub (CI/CD) group -- targeted ACM, CloudFront, IAM, Lambda, Route53,
# S3 and SQS actions.
resource "aws_iam_group" "github" {
  name = "github"
  path = local.github_group_path
}

resource "aws_iam_group_policy" "github" {
  name   = "github"
  group  = aws_iam_group.github.name
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.github.json
}

# Serverless group -- dedicated policy covering ACM, CloudFront, IAM, Lambda,
# CloudWatch Logs, Route53, S3 and SQS actions.
resource "aws_iam_group" "serverless" {
  name = "serverless"
  path = local.serverless_path
}

resource "aws_iam_group_policy" "serverless" {
  name   = "serverless"
  group  = aws_iam_group.serverless.name
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.serverless.json
}

###############################################################################
# IAM governance stack for AWS Service Catalog testing
#
# Resources:
#   - aws_iam_role               "test_role"  (assumable by Service Catalog)
#   - aws_iam_policy             "launch_constraint" (scoped permissions)
#   - aws_iam_role_policy_attachment
#   - aws_iam_group              "test_group"
#   - aws_iam_user               "test_user"  (console enabled via login profile)
#   - aws_iam_user_group_membership
###############################################################################

locals {
  role_name  = "test_role"
  group_name = "test_group"
  user_name  = "test_user"

  common_tags = {
    Environment = "test"
    ManagedBy   = "terraform"
    Purpose     = "service-catalog-testing"
  }
}

data "aws_partition" "current" {}

###############################################################################
# Trust policy - allow AWS Service Catalog to assume the launch-constraint role
###############################################################################
data "aws_iam_policy_document" "service_catalog_assume_role" {
  statement {
    sid     = "AllowServiceCatalogToAssumeRole"
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]

    principals {
      type        = "Service"
      identifiers = ["servicecatalog.amazonaws.com"]
    }
  }
}

###############################################################################
# Scoped launch-constraint policy
#
# Service Catalog assumes the launch-constraint role to provision the products
# that a user launches. Permissions are scoped to the specific provisioning
# actions required, with CloudFormation actions limited to stack resources.
###############################################################################
data "aws_iam_policy_document" "launch_constraint" {
  statement {
    sid    = "CloudFormationStackProvisioning"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "cloudformation:CreateStack",
      "cloudformation:UpdateStack",
      "cloudformation:DeleteStack",
      "cloudformation:DescribeStacks",
      "cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents",
      "cloudformation:DescribeStackResources",
      "cloudformation:GetTemplateSummary",
      "cloudformation:ValidateTemplate",
    ]

    resources = [
      "arn:${data.aws_partition.current.partition}:cloudformation:*:*:stack/*/*",
    ]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "ProvisioningReadAccess"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones",
      "ec2:DescribeImages",
      "ec2:DescribeInstances",
      "ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes",

###############################################################################
# Variables
###############################################################################

variable "environment" {
  description = "Environment suffix appended to every IAM user / resource name."
  type        = string
  default     = "dev"
}

variable "create_db_dr_user" {
  description = "Conditional toggle that controls creation of the database disaster recovery IAM user."
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

variable "create_data_exports_user" {
  description = "Conditional toggle that controls creation of the data exports IAM user."
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

variable "create_packer_user" {
  description = "Conditional toggle that controls creation of the Packer image builder IAM user."
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

variable "s3_export_bucket_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the S3 bucket used for data exports (consumed by the data exports user)."
  type        = string
  default     = ""
}

variable "s3_monitoring_state_bucket_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the S3 bucket that stores Packer / monitoring state."
  type        = string
  default     = ""
}

variable "server_role_name" {
  description = "Base name of the dedicated server IAM role the Packer builder is allowed to pass."
  type        = string
  default     = "mattermost-server"
}

variable "lambda_function_name" {
  description = "Name of the Lambda function used for bind-server network attachment."
  type        = string
  default     = "bind-server-network-attachment"
}

###############################################################################
# Provider metadata (static, well-known lookups only)
###############################################################################

data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}
data "aws_region" "current" {}
data "aws_partition" "current" {}

###############################################################################
# Locals
###############################################################################

locals {
  account_id = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id
  region     = data.aws_region.current.name
  partition  = data.aws_partition.current.partition

  tags = {
    Environment = var.environment
    ManagedBy   = "terraform"
  }

  server_role_name = "${var.server_role_name}-${var.environment}"
  server_role_arn  = "arn:${local.partition}:iam::${local.account_id}:role/${local.server_role_name}"

  lambda_function_arn = "arn:${local.partition}:lambda:${local.region}:${local.account_id}:function:${var.lambda_function_name}"

  secrets_rds_path_arn = "arn:${local.partition}:secretsmanager:${local.region}:${local.account_id}:secret:rds-cluster-multitenant-*"
}

###############################################################################
# Mandatory: cost reporting IAM user
###############################################################################

resource "aws_iam_user" "cost_report" {
  name = "mattermost-cost-report-${var.environment}"
  path = "/"
  tags = local.tags
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "cost_report" {
  statement {
    sid       = "CostExplorerFullAccess"
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = ["ce:*"]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_user_policy" "cost_report" {
  name   = "mattermost-cost-report-${var.environment}"
  user   = aws_iam_user.cost_report.name
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.cost_report.json
}

###############################################################################
# Optional: database disaster recovery IAM user
###############################################################################

resource "aws_iam_user" "db_dr" {
  count = var.create_db_dr_user ? 1 : 0

  name = "mattermost-db-dr-${var.environment}"
  path = "/"
  tags = local.tags
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "db_dr" {
  statement {
    sid       = "RDSAndKMSFullAccess"
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = ["rds:*", "kms:*"]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "SecretsManagerMultitenantRDS"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "secretsmanager:GetSecretValue",
      "secretsmanager:DescribeSecret",
      "secretsmanager:ListSecretVersionIds",
      "secretsmanager:GetRandomPassword",
      "secretsmanager:PutSecretValue",
      "secretsmanager:UpdateSecret",
      "secretsmanager:RestoreSecret",
      "secretsmanager:TagResource",
      "secretsmanager:UntagResource",
    ]
    resources = [local.secrets_rds_path_arn]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_user_policy" "db_dr" {
  count = var.create_db_dr_user ? 1 : 0

  name   = "mattermost-db-dr-${var.environment}"
  user   = aws_iam_user.db_dr[0].name
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.db_dr.json
}

###############################################################################
# Optional: data exports IAM user
###############################################################################

resource "aws_iam_user" "data_exports" {
  count = var.create_data_exports_user ? 1 : 0

  name = "mattermost-data-exports-${var.environment}"
  path = "/"
  tags = local.tags
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "data_exports" {
  statement {
    sid    = "ListExportBuckets"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "s3:ListBucket",
      "s3:GetBucketLocation",
      "s3:ListAllMyBuckets",
    ]
    resources = [var.s3_export_bucket_arn]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "ReadWriteExportObjects"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "s3:GetObject",
      "s3:PutObject",
      "s3:DeleteObject",
      "s3:AbortMultipartUpload",
      "s3:ListMultipartUploadParts",
    ]
    resources = ["${var.s3_export_bucket_arn}/*"]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_user_policy" "data_exports" {
  count = var.create_data_exports_user ? 1 : 0

  name   = "mattermost-data-exports-${var.environment}"
  user   = aws_iam_user.data_exports[0].name
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.data_exports.json
}

###############################################################################
# Optional: Packer image builder IAM user
###############################################################################

resource "aws_iam_user" "packer" {
  count = var.create_packer_user ? 1 : 0

  name = "mattermost-packer-${var.environment}"
  path = "/"
  tags = local.tags
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "packer" {
  statement {
    sid    = "EC2ImageBuildPermissions"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:AttachVolume",
      "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress",
      "ec2:CopyImage",
      "ec2:CreateImage",
      "ec2:CreateKeyPair",
      "ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate",
      "ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion",
      "ec2:CreateSecurityGroup",
      "ec2:CreateSnapshot",
      "ec2:CreateTags",
      "ec2:CreateVolume",
      "ec2:DeleteKeyPair",
      "ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate",
      "ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup",
      "ec2:DeleteSnapshot",
      "ec2:DeleteVolume",
      "ec2:DeregisterImage",
      "ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes",
      "ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones",
      "ec2:DescribeImageAttribute",
      "ec2:DescribeImages",
      "ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus",
      "ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes",
      "ec2:DescribeInstances",
      "ec2:DescribeKeyPairs",
      "ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions",
      "ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates",
      "ec2:DescribeRegions",
      "ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups",
      "ec2:DescribeSnapshots",
      "ec2:DescribeSubnets",
      "ec2:DescribeTags",
      "ec2:DescribeVolumes",
      "ec2:DescribeVpcs",
      "ec2:DetachVolume",
      "ec2:GetConsoleOutput",
      "ec2:ModifyImageAttribute",
      "ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute",
      "ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute",
      "ec2:RegisterImage",
      "ec2:RunInstances",
      "ec2:StopInstances",
      "ec2:TerminateInstances",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "AutoScalingPermissions"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "autoscaling:AttachInstances",
      "autoscaling:CompleteLifecycleAction",
      "autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup",
      "autoscaling:CreateLaunchConfiguration",
      "autoscaling:CreateOrUpdateTags",
      "autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup",
      "autoscaling:DeleteLaunchConfiguration",
      "autoscaling:DeleteLifecycleHook",
      "autoscaling:DeleteTags",
      "autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups",
      "autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances",
      "autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations",
      "autoscaling:DescribeLifecycleHooks",
      "autoscaling:DescribeScalingActivities",
      "autoscaling:DescribeTags",
      "autoscaling:DetachInstances",
      "autoscaling:EnterStandby",
      "autoscaling:ExitStandby",
      "autoscaling:PutLifecycleHook",
      "autoscaling:PutNotificationConfiguration",
      "autoscaling:RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat",
      "autoscaling:ResumeProcesses",
      "autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity",
      "autoscaling:SuspendProcesses",
      "autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup",
      "autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "CloudWatchEventsPermissions"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "events:DeleteRule",
      "events:DescribeRule",
      "events:DisableRule",
      "events:EnableRule",
      "events:ListRules",
      "events:ListTagsForResource",
      "events:ListTargetsByRule",
      "events:PutRule",
      "events:PutTargets",
      "events:RemoveTargets",
      "events:TagResource",
      "events:UntagResource",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "SSMParameterPermissions"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ssm:AddTagsToResource",
      "ssm:DeleteParameter",
      "ssm:DescribeParameters",
      "ssm:GetParameter",
      "ssm:GetParameters",
      "ssm:GetParametersByPath",
      "ssm:ListTagsForResource",
      "ssm:PutParameter",
      "ssm:RemoveTagsFromResource",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "IAMInstanceProfileAndRoleInspection"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "iam:GetInstanceProfile",
      "iam:GetRole",
      "iam:GetRolePolicy",
      "iam:ListInstanceProfiles",
      "iam:ListInstanceProfilesForRole",
      "iam:ListRolePolicies",
      "iam:ListRoles",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "MonitoringStateBucketAccess"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "s3:GetObject",
      "s3:ListBucket",
      "s3:PutObject",
    ]
    resources = [
      var.s3_monitoring_state_bucket_arn,
      "${var.s3_monitoring_state_bucket_arn}/*",
    ]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "BindServerNetworkAttachmentLambdaConfig"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "lambda:AddPermission",
      "lambda:GetFunction",
      "lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration",
      "lambda:GetPolicy",
      "lambda:ListTags",
      "lambda:RemovePermission",
      "lambda:TagResource",
      "lambda:UntagResource",
      "lambda:UpdateFunctionCode",
      "lambda:UpdateFunctionConfiguration",
    ]
    resources = [local.lambda_function_arn]
  }

  statement {
    sid       = "PassDedicatedServerRole"
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = ["iam:PassRole"]
    resources = [local.server_role_arn]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_user_policy" "packer" {
  count = var.create_packer_user ? 1 : 0

  name   = "mattermost-packer-${var.environment}"
  user   = aws_iam_user.packer[0].name
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.packer.json
}

###############################################################################
# Secure, self-contained VPC network stack
#
# Built on the CloudPosse community modules:
#   - cloudposse/label/null           shared naming/tagging context
#   - cloudposse/vpc/aws              VPC, IGW, DNS, default SG deny-all
#   - cloudposse/dynamic-subnets/aws  public/private subnets + NAT gateways
#
# Private endpoint access is provided by a gateway endpoint for S3 and
# interface (AWS PrivateLink) endpoints for ECR (docker + api), CloudWatch
# Logs, SSM and KMS, all gated by a dedicated "vpc_endpoint_sg" security group
# that only permits HTTPS (TCP/443) traffic between its own members.
###############################################################################

###############################################################################
# Variables
###############################################################################

variable "vpc_name" {
  description = "Name of the VPC and base label for the network resources."
  type        = string
  default     = "benchmark-vpc"
}

variable "vpc_cidr" {
  description = "Primary IPv4 CIDR block assigned to the VPC."
  type        = string
  default     = "172.16.0.0/16"
}

variable "region" {
  description = "AWS region used to build VPC endpoint service names."
  type        = string
  default     = "us-east-1"
}

variable "availability_zones" {
  description = "Explicit availability zones for subnet provisioning. Defaults to the first three AZs of the region."
  type        = list(string)
  default     = []
}

###############################################################################
# Data sources
###############################################################################

data "aws_availability_zones" "available" {
  state = "available"
}

###############################################################################
# Locals
###############################################################################

locals {
  # VPC endpoint service names are always of the form
  # com.amazonaws.<region>.<service>.
  service_name_prefix = "com.amazonaws.${var.region}"

  # Use the caller-supplied AZ list when present, otherwise spread across the
  # first three AZs of the region (bounded by how many the region actually
  # exposes so slice() can never run off the end of the list).
  availability_zones = length(var.availability_zones) > 0 ? var.availability_zones : slice(
    data.aws_availability_zones.available.names,
    0,
    min(3, length(data.aws_availability_zones.available.names)),
  )

  # Interface (AWS PrivateLink) endpoints required by the containerized
  # workloads. All are placed in the private subnets with private DNS enabled.
  interface_endpoints = {
    ecr_docker = "${local.service_name_prefix}.ecr.dkr"
    ecr_api    = "${local.service_name_prefix}.ecr.api"
    logs       = "${local.service_name_prefix}.logs"
    ssm        = "${local.service_name_prefix}.ssm"
    kms        = "${local.service_name_prefix}.kms"
  }

  # Gateway endpoint used to reach S3 without leaving the AWS network.
  s3_gateway_endpoint = "${local.service_name_prefix}.s3"
}

###############################################################################
# Shared naming / tagging context (CloudPosse label module)
###############################################################################

module "label" {
  source  = "cloudposse/label/null"
  version = "0.25.0"

  name      = var.vpc_name
  delimiter = "-"
}

###############################################################################
# VPC (CloudPosse)
###############################################################################

module "vpc" {
  source  = "cloudposse/vpc/aws"
  version = "2.1.1"

  # Primary IPv4 CIDR for the network.
  ipv4_primary_cidr_block = var.vpc_cidr

  # DNS hostnames enabled, generated IPv6 CIDR disabled.
  dns_hostnames_enabled            = true
  dns_support_enabled              = true
  assign_generated_ipv6_cidr_block = false

  # Lock the default security group down to deny-all.
  default_security_group_deny_all = true

  # Outbound internet routing for the public/NAT layer.
  internet_gateway_enabled = true

  context = module.label.context
}

###############################################################################
# Public + private subnets with NAT gateways (CloudPosse)
###############################################################################

module "subnets" {
  source  = "cloudposse/dynamic-subnets/aws"
  version = "2.4.1"

  availability_zones = local.availability_zones
  vpc_id             = module.vpc.vpc_id
  igw_id             = [module.vpc.igw_id]
  ipv4_cidr_block    = [module.vpc.vpc_cidr_block]

  public_subnets_enabled  = true
  private_subnets_enabled = true

  # NAT gateways give the private subnets outbound connectivity.
  nat_gateway_enabled  = true
  nat_instance_enabled = false

  # Do not hand public IPs to instances launched in the public subnets.
  map_public_ip_on_launch = false

  context = module.label.context
}

###############################################################################
# Security group controlling access to the interface endpoints
###############################################################################

resource "aws_security_group" "vpc_endpoint_sg" {
  name        = "vpc_endpoint_sg"
  description = "Allows HTTPS (TCP/443) traffic between members of the VPC interface endpoints"
  vpc_id      = module.vpc.vpc_id

  ingress {
    description = "Self-referencing HTTPS ingress from endpoint clients"
    from_port   = 443
    to_port     = 443
    protocol    = "tcp"
    self        = true
  }

  egress {
    description = "Self-referencing HTTPS egress to endpoint clients"
    from_port   = 443
    to_port     = 443
    protocol    = "tcp"
    self        = true
  }

  tags = merge(module.label.tags, { Name = "vpc_endpoint_sg" })
}

###############################################################################
# S3 Gateway VPC endpoint
###############################################################################

resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "s3" {
  vpc_id            = module.vpc.vpc_id
  service_name      = local.s3_gateway_endpoint
  vpc_endpoint_type = "Gateway"

  route_table_ids = distinct(concat(
    module.subnets.public_route_table_ids,
    module.subnets.private_route_table_ids,
    [module.vpc.vpc_default_route_table_id],
  ))

  tags = merge(module.label.tags, { Name = "${var.vpc_name}-s3-endpoint" })
}

###############################################################################
# Interface (PrivateLink) VPC endpoints
###############################################################################

resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "interface" {
  for_each = local.interface_endpoints

  vpc_id              = module.vpc.vpc_id
  service_name        = each.value
  vpc_endpoint_type   = "Interface"
  subnet_ids          = module.subnets.private_subnet_ids
  security_group_ids  = [aws_security_group.vpc_endpoint_sg.id]
  private_dns_enabled = true

  tags = merge(module.label.tags, { Name = "${var.vpc_name}-${each.key}-endpoint" })
}

  sqs_managed_sse_enabled = true
}

###############################################################################
# Terraform configuration: Cross-account CloudHealth IAM role + read-only policy
#
# Creates:
#   * A customer-managed IAM policy "CloudHealth-IAM-Role" containing broad
#     read-only describe/list/get permissions used for cost & usage analysis.
#   * An IAM role "CloudHealth-IAM-Role" that the CloudHealth SaaS platform AWS
#     account is allowed to assume, guarded by an sts:ExternalId condition.
#   * A managed policy attachment binding the policy to the role.
###############################################################################

terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.3.0"

  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = ">= 4.0"
    }
  }
}

###############################################################################
# Inputs
###############################################################################

variable "cloudhealth_account_id" {
  description = "AWS account ID of the CloudHealth SaaS platform that is permitted to assume the role."
  type        = string
  default     = "454464851268"
}

variable "cloudhealth_external_id" {
  description = "External ID that CloudHealth must supply when assuming the role (Confused Deputy protection)."
  type        = string
  default     = "cloudhealth-external-id"
}

variable "role_name" {
  description = "Name shared by the IAM role and the customer-managed IAM policy."
  type        = string
  default     = "CloudHealth-IAM-Role"
}

variable "role_max_session_duration" {
  description = "Maximum session duration (seconds) for assume-role sessions."
  type        = number
  default     = 43200
}

variable "tags" {
  description = "Common tags applied to all created resources."
  type        = map(string)
  default = {
    ManagedBy = "Terraform"
    Purpose   = "CloudHealthCostAndUsage"
  }
}

###############################################################################
# Static provider metadata (no pre-existing remote state required)
###############################################################################

data "aws_partition" "current" {}

###############################################################################
# Locals
###############################################################################

locals {
  role_name = var.role_name

  cloudhealth_principal_arn = "arn:${data.aws_partition.current.partition}:iam::${var.cloudhealth_account_id}:root"
}

###############################################################################
# Trust policy: allow the CloudHealth account to assume the role, but only when
# the correct external ID is supplied (protects against the confused deputy
# problem).
###############################################################################

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "cloudhealth_assume_role" {
  statement {
    sid     = "AllowCloudHealthAssumeRoleWithExternalId"
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = [local.cloudhealth_principal_arn]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "sts:ExternalId"
      values   = [var.cloudhealth_external_id]
    }
  }
}

###############################################################################
# Cross-account IAM role
###############################################################################

resource "aws_iam_role" "cloudhealth" {
  name                 = local.role_name
  description          = "Cross-account role assumed by the CloudHealth SaaS platform for cost and usage analysis."
  assume_role_policy   = data.aws_iam_policy_document.cloudhealth_assume_role.json
  max_session_duration = var.role_max_session_duration

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = local.role_name })
}

###############################################################################
# Customer-managed read-only policy
#
# Every statement scopes Action to an explicit set of describe/list/get
# operations, so no single statement ever combines a wildcard Action with a
# wildcard Resource.
###############################################################################

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "cloudhealth_readonly" {
  # --- Cost, billing and budgeting -----------------------------------------
  statement {
    sid    = "CostBillingAndBudgetsReadOnly"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "ce:Get*",
      "ce:Describe*",
      "ce:List*",
      "cur:Describe*",
      "budgets:ViewBudget",
      "budgets:Describe*",
      "savingsplans:Describe*",
      "savingsplans:List*",
      "pricing:GetProducts",
      "pricing:Describe*",
      "aws-portal:ViewBilling",
      "aws-portal:ViewUsage",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]
  }

  # --- Compute --------------------------------------------------------------
  statement {
    sid    = "ComputeReadOnly"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "ec2:Describe*",
      "ec2:Get*",
      "autoscaling:Describe*",
      "lambda:List*",
      "lambda:Get*",
      "ecs:List*",
      "ecs:Describe*",
      "eks:List*",
      "eks:Describe*",
      "batch:Describe*",
      "batch:List*",
      "elasticbeanstalk:Describe*",
      "elasticbeanstalk:List*",
      "apprunner:List*",
      "apprunner:Describe*",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]
  }

  # --- Storage, databases and caching --------------------------------------
  statement {
    sid    = "StorageDatabaseAndCacheReadOnly"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "s3:GetBucketLocation",
      "s3:GetBucketAcl",
      "s3:GetBucketPolicy",
      "s3:GetBucketTagging",
      "s3:GetBucketLogging",
      "s3:GetBucketVersioning",
      "s3:GetLifecycleConfiguration",
      "s3:ListAllMyBuckets",
      "s3:ListBucket",
      "s3:ListBuckets",
      "rds:Describe*",
      "rds:List*",
      "dynamodb:Describe*",
      "dynamodb:List*",
      "redshift:Describe*",
      "elasticache:Describe*",
      "elasticache:List*",
      "efs:Describe*",
      "backup:List*",
      "backup:Describe*",
      "backup:Get*",
      "fsx:Describe*",
      "storagegateway:List*",
      "storagegateway:Describe*",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]
  }

  # --- Networking and content delivery -------------------------------------
  statement {
    sid    = "NetworkingAndDeliveryReadOnly"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "elasticloadbalancing:Describe*",
      "cloudfront:List*",
      "cloudfront:Get*",
      "route53:List*",
      "route53:Get*",
      "apigateway:GET",
      "directconnect:Describe*",
      "globalaccelerator:List*",
      "globalaccelerator:Describe*",
      "networkfirewall:List*",
      "networkfirewall:Describe*",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]
  }

  # --- Analytics, integration and ML ---------------------------------------
  statement {
    sid    = "AnalyticsIntegrationAndMLReadOnly"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "kinesis:List*",
      "kinesis:Describe*",
      "firehose:List*",
      "firehose:Describe*",
      "glue:Get*",
      "glue:List*",
      "athena:List*",
      "athena:Get*",
      "emr:Describe*",
      "emr:List*",
      "sns:List*",
      "sns:Get*",
      "sqs:List*",
      "sqs:Get*",
      "ses:Get*",
      "ses:List*",
      "sagemaker:List*",
      "sagemaker:Describe*",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]
  }

  # --- Management, governance and security ---------------------------------
  statement {
    sid    = "ManagementGovernanceAndSecurityReadOnly"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "cloudwatch:Get*",
      "cloudwatch:List*",
      "cloudwatch:Describe*",
      "cloudwatch:Generate*",
      "logs:Describe*",
      "logs:List*",
      "cloudformation:Describe*",
      "cloudformation:List*",
      "cloudformation:Get*",
      "cloudtrail:Describe*",
      "cloudtrail:List*",
      "cloudtrail:Get*",
      "config:Describe*",
      "config:List*",
      "config:Get*",
      "organizations:Describe*",
      "organizations:List*",
      "controltower:List*",
      "controltower:Get*",
      "servicecatalog:List*",
      "servicecatalog:Describe*",
      "guardduty:List*",
      "guardduty:Get*",
      "securityhub:List*",
      "securityhub:Get*",
      "health:Describe*",
      "support:Describe*",
      "trustedadvisor:Describe*",
      "ssm:Describe*",
      "ssm:List*",
      "kms:List*",
      "kms:Describe*",
      "acm:List*",
      "acm:Describe*",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]
  }

  # --- Resource tagging, resource groups and identity ----------------------
  statement {
    sid    = "TaggingResourceGroupsAndIdentityReadOnly"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      "tag:GetResources",
      "tag:GetTagKeys",
      "tag:GetTagValues",
      "resource-groups:List*",
      "resource-groups:Get*",
      "iam:Get*",
      "iam:List*",
      "sts:GetCallerIdentity",
    ]

    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "cloudhealth_readonly" {
  name        = local.role_name
  description = "Broad read-only (describe, list, get) permissions across AWS services for CloudHealth cost and usage analysis."
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.cloudhealth_readonly.json

  tags = merge(var.tags, { Name = local.role_name })
}

###############################################################################
# Attach the customer-managed policy to the role
###############################################################################

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "cloudhealth_readonly" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.cloudhealth.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.cloudhealth_readonly.arn
}

locals {
  vpc_name         = "swe-vpc"
  vpc_cidr         = "10.0.0.0/16"
  resource_group   = "default"
  default_acl_name = "${local.vpc_name}-default_acl"
  default_sg_name  = "${local.vpc_name}-default_sg"
  any_cidr         = "0.0.0.0/0"
  ssh_port         = 22
  rdp_port         = 3389
  http_port        = 80
}

resource "aws_vpc" "main" {
  cidr_block           = local.vpc_cidr
  instance_tenancy     = "default"
  enable_dns_support   = true
  enable_dns_hostnames = true

  tags = {
    Name          = local.vpc_name
    ResourceGroup = local.resource_group
  }
}

# Take over the VPC's default network ACL and manage its rules.
resource "aws_default_network_acl" "main" {
  default_network_acl_id = aws_vpc.main.default_network_acl_id

  # Allow all traffic within the VPC's own CIDR block.
  ingress {
    protocol   = "-1"
    rule_no    = 100
    action     = "allow"
    cidr_block = local.vpc_cidr
    from_port  = 0
    to_port    = 0
  }

  # Explicitly deny inbound SSH from any external address.
  ingress {
    protocol   = "tcp"
    rule_no    = 200
    action     = "deny"
    cidr_block = local.any_cidr
    from_port  = local.ssh_port
    to_port    = local.ssh_port
  }

  # Explicitly deny inbound RDP from any external address.
  ingress {
    protocol   = "tcp"
    rule_no    = 210
    action     = "deny"
    cidr_block = local.any_cidr
    from_port  = local.rdp_port
    to_port    = local.rdp_port
  }

  # Allow all traffic within the VPC's own CIDR block.
  egress {
    protocol   = "-1"
    rule_no    = 100
    action     = "allow"
    cidr_block = local.vpc_cidr
    from_port  = 0
    to_port    = 0
  }

  tags = {
    Name          = local.default_acl_name
    ResourceGroup = local.resource_group
  }
}

# Take over the VPC's default security group with no rules of its own.
resource "aws_default_security_group" "main" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  tags = {
    Name          = local.default_sg_name
    ResourceGroup = local.resource_group
  }
}

# Separate inbound rule allowing ICMP echo (ping) from anywhere.
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "allow_icmp_echo" {
  type              = "ingress"
  security_group_id = aws_default_security_group.main.id
  protocol          = "icmp"
  from_port         = 8
  to_port           = 0
  cidr_blocks       = [local.any_cidr]
}

# Separate inbound rule allowing HTTP on port 80 from anywhere.
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "allow_http" {
  type              = "ingress"
  security_group_id = aws_default_security_group.main.id
  protocol          = "tcp"
  from_port         = local.http_port
  to_port           = local.http_port
  cidr_blocks       = [local.any_cidr]
}

variable "callback_urls" {
  description = "Allowed callback URLs for the Cognito app clients."
  type        = list(string)
  default = [
    "https://localhost:8080/oauth2/callback",
    "https://api.example.com/oauth2/callback",
  ]
}

variable "logout_urls" {
  description = "Allowed logout URLs for the Cognito app clients."
  type        = list(string)
  default = [
    "https://localhost:8080/logout",
    "https://api.example.com/logout",
  ]
}

locals {
  ssm_user_pool_id_path  = "/unity/cs/security/shared-services-cognito-user-pool/user-pool-id"
  hosted_ui_domain_prefix = "unity-shared-services-test"

  oauth_flows        = ["code"]
  oauth_scopes       = ["email", "openid"]
  identity_providers = ["COGNITO"]

  password_auth_flows    = ["ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH", "ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH", "ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH"]
  no_password_auth_flows = ["ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH", "ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH"]
}

resource "aws_cognito_user_pool" "main" {
  name = "unity-shared-services-user-pool"

  # Only administrators may create users. Invitation email + SMS messages
  # are customized to deliver the username and temporary password.
  admin_create_user_config {
    allow_admin_create_user_only = true

    invite_message_template {
      email_subject = "Your Unity Shared Services account"
      email_message = "Your username is {username} and your temporary password is {####}."
      sms_message   = "Your username is {username} and your temporary password is {####}."
    }
  }

  account_recovery_setting {
    recovery_mechanism {
      name     = "verified_email"
      priority = 1
    }
  }

  auto_verified_attributes = ["email"]

  password_policy {
    minimum_length                   = 12
    require_lowercase                = true
    require_uppercase                = true
    require_numbers                  = true
    require_symbols                  = true
    temporary_password_validity_days = 7
  }

  mfa_configuration   = "OFF"
  deletion_protection = "ACTIVE"

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

resource "aws_cognito_user_pool_domain" "main" {
  domain       = local.hosted_ui_domain_prefix
  user_pool_id = aws_cognito_user_pool.main.id
}

resource "aws_ssm_parameter" "user_pool_id" {
  name  = local.ssm_user_pool_id_path
  type  = "String"
  value = aws_cognito_user_pool.main.id
}

resource "aws_cognito_user_pool_client" "uds_distribution" {
  name         = "unity-uds-distribution-user-pool-client"
  user_pool_id = aws_cognito_user_pool.main.id

  generate_secret = true

  allowed_oauth_flows_user_pool_client = true
  allowed_oauth_flows                  = local.oauth_flows
  allowed_oauth_scopes                 = local.oauth_scopes
  supported_identity_providers         = local.identity_providers

  callback_urls = var.callback_urls
  logout_urls   = var.logout_urls

  explicit_auth_flows          = local.password_auth_flows
  prevent_user_existence_errors = "ENABLED"
}

resource "aws_cognito_user_pool_client" "localhost_jupyterhub" {
  name         = "localhost-jupyterhub-user-pool-client"
  user_pool_id = aws_cognito_user_pool.main.id

  generate_secret = true

  allowed_oauth_flows_user_pool_client = true
  allowed_oauth_flows                  = local.oauth_flows
  allowed_oauth_scopes                 = local.oauth_scopes
  supported_identity_providers         = local.identity_providers

  callback_urls = var.callback_urls
  logout_urls   = var.logout_urls

  explicit_auth_flows          = local.password_auth_flows
  prevent_user_existence_errors = "ENABLED"
}

resource "aws_cognito_user_pool_client" "app_to_app" {
  name         = "unity-app-to-app-client-user-pool-client"
  user_pool_id = aws_cognito_user_pool.main.id

  generate_secret = true

  allowed_oauth_flows_user_pool_client = true
  allowed_oauth_flows                  = local.oauth_flows
  allowed_oauth_scopes                 = local.oauth_scopes
  supported_identity_providers         = local.identity_providers

  callback_urls = var.callback_urls
  logout_urls   = var.logout_urls

  # Username/password authentication is not permitted for this client.
  explicit_auth_flows          = local.no_password_auth_flows
  prevent_user_existence_errors = "ENABLED"
}

resource "aws_cognito_user_pool_client" "uads_jupyter_development" {
  name         = "uads-jupyter-development-client-user-pool-client"
  user_pool_id = aws_cognito_user_pool.main.id

  generate_secret = true

  allowed_oauth_flows_user_pool_client = true
  allowed_oauth_flows                  = local.oauth_flows
  allowed_oauth_scopes                 = local.oauth_scopes
  supported_identity_providers         = local.identity_providers

  callback_urls = var.callback_urls
  logout_urls   = var.logout_urls

  # Username/password authentication is not permitted for this client.
  explicit_auth_flows          = local.no_password_auth_flows
  prevent_user_existence_errors = "ENABLED"
}

resource "aws_cognito_user_pool_client" "hysds_ui" {
  name         = "hysds-ui-client-user-pool-client"
  user_pool_id = aws_cognito_user_pool.main.id

  generate_secret = false

  allowed_oauth_flows_user_pool_client = true
  allowed_oauth_flows                  = local.oauth_flows

  callback_urls = var.callback_urls
  logout_urls   = var.logout_urls

  explicit_auth_flows          = local.password_auth_flows
  prevent_user_existence_errors = "ENABLED"
}

  name         = "localhost-hysds-ui-client-user-pool-client"
  user_pool_id = aws_cognito_user_pool.main.id

  generate_secret = false

  allowed_oauth_flows_user_pool_client = true
  allowed_oauth_flows                  = local.oauth_flows
  allowed_oauth_scopes                 = local.oauth_scopes
  supported_identity_providers         = local.identity_providers

  logout_urls   = var.logout_urls

  explicit_auth_flows          = local.password_auth_flows
  prevent_user_existence_errors = "ENABLED"
}

resource "aws_cognito_user_group" "unity_admin" {
  name         = "Unity_Admin"
  user_pool_id = aws_cognito_user_pool.main.id
}

  name         = "Unity_Viewer"
  user_pool_id = aws_cognito_user_pool.main.id
}
